kjv: sanctify the Lord God in your hearts
mine: in your hearts honor Christ the Lord as holy
note: TR "ton theon" against "ton Christon" (P72, Sinaiticus, A, B, C); the early text applies Isa 8:13 ("the LORD") to Christ.

kjv: suffered for sins … quickened by the Spirit
mine: suffered once for sins … made alive in the spirit
note: pneumati parallel to "sarki" (flesh/spirit, two spheres) is better "in the spirit" than "by the Spirit", which the KJV capitalisation implies.

kjv: the answer of a good conscience toward God
mine: an appeal to God for a good conscience
note: eperotema is a request or pledge (perhaps the baptismal vow), not an "answer".
